questions.question: Triangle ABC is an isosceles triangle in which ∠C = 90°. If AC = 8 cm, find AB.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7874fedf8b6fbb6c195926b5322ab43ff599d143384219d3156b6c3e75a36860.png] 

**Given:**

Triangle ABC is an isosceles triangle in which ∠C = 90° & AC = 8 cm.

**Concept:**

AC + BC > AB [Sum of two sides of a triangle is greater than the third side]

AB > AC or BC [Hypotenuse is greater than the Base or Altitude of any right-angle triangle]

Pythagoras Theorem: 

⇒ AB² = AC² + BC²

**Calculation:**

ABC is an isosceles triangle; AC = 8 cm 

⇒ BC = 8 cm 

AB2 = 8² + 82

⇒ AB = √128 

**∴ AB = 8√2 cm**

questions.question: Find the greatest number less than 500 that is divisible by 6, 14 and 28.
questions.solution:

The required number; 84k < 500 [where k is any natural number]

For k = 1, 84 × 1 = 84 

For k = 2, 84 × 2 = 168

For k = 3, 84 × 3 = 252

For k = 4, 84 × 4 = 336

questions.question: If x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴) = 194 find x³ + (1)/(x³)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴) = 194

**Formulas used:**

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

(x + y)³ = x³ + y³ + 3xy(x + y)

**Calculation:**

 x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴) = 194

By adding 2 in both sides:- 

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 194 + 2

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = 196 

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) = √196 

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) = 14 (1) 

By adding 2 in both sides of equation (1)

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) + 2 = 14 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 16 

⇒ (x + 1/x) = 4 (2)

Now, cubing both sides in equation (2)

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = 4³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × x × 1/x (x + 1/x) = 64

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 3 × 4 = 64 

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 64 - 12 = 52

**∴ The required result is 52.**

questions.question: By selling an article for Rs. 45,000, a man loses 10%. For what amount should he sell it so as to gain 15%.

New Selling Price = 115% of the Cost Price 

Now, 90% = 45000

⇒ 1% = 500

⇒ 100% = 50000 (C.P)

⇒ 115% = 115 × 1% = 115 × 500 

⇒ 57500

**∴ The required Selling Price should be Rs. 57500**

__**Basic Method:**__

**Given:**

Selling Price = Rs.45000 at 10% loss

**Formula used:**

Cost Price is 100% of itself and Profit or loss is calculated on the Cost Price of the article. 

Selling Price at a loss of y% = Cost Price × (100 - y)%

Selling Price at a gain of y% = Cost Price × (100 + y)%

**Calculation:**

Rs.45000 = (100 - 10)% of Cost Price

⇒ 45000 = 90% of Cost Price

⇒ 45000/90% = 1% of Cost Price 

⇒ 45000 × 100%/90% = 100% of Cost Price 

⇒ Cost Price (100%) = 50000

Selling Price at 15% gain:- 

⇒ 50000 × (100 + 15)% 

⇒ 50000 × 115/100 

⇒ 57500

**∴ The selling price at 15% gain is Rs.57500.**

Profit % = (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100

**Calculation:**

Let Cost price be 100a 

Selling Price = 45000

Loss % = 10

⇒ (Cost price - Selling price)/Cost price × 100 = 10 

⇒ (100a - 45000)/100a × 100 = 10 

⇒ (100a - 45000)/a = 10 

⇒ (100a - 45000) = 10a 

⇒ 90a = 45000 

⇒ 100a = 45000 × 100a/90a 

∴ 100a (CP) = 50000

Profit percent = 15% 

(SP - 50000)/50000 × 100 = 15

⇒ SP - 50000 = 7500

**∴ SP = 7500 + 50000 = 57500**

questions.question: If the length and breadth of a rectangular plot of land are increased by 10% and 8% respectively, then by how much percentage will its area increase or decrease?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage increase in length = 10%

Percentage increase in breadth = 8%

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = length × breadth 

Percentage increase/decrease = Increase/decrease ÷ Old area × 100 

**Calculation:**

Let the length and breadth of rectangle be 100cm and 50 cm respectively. 

⇒ Area = 100 × 50 = 5000 sq. cm 

Now, increased length = 100 × 110/100 = 110 cm 

⇒ Increased breadth = 50 × 108/100 = 54 

New area = 110 × 54 = 5940

∴ Percentage increase in area = (5940 - 5000)/5000 × 100 

**⇒ 940/5000 × 100 = 18.8%**

Effective rate of increase = x + y + xy/100 

**Calculation:**

**⇒ 18 + 0.8 = 18.8% **

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 20 days. B and C can complete it in 30 days. A is twice as good as C in completing the work. Find in how many days will B alone complete it.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A and B = 20 days 

Time taken by B and C = 30 days 

**Formula used:**

Total work = No of days × Efficiency 

The ratio of efficiency of A and C = 2 : 1 

⇒ A/C = 2 : 1

⇒ 2C = A

**Calculation:**

By LCM Method, let the total work be the common multiple of 20 and 30, that is 60. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cfae69a081547c837e1fa59cce7478dd8cea13f121437608356c4aaa146f3d9.png] 

One day work done by (A + B) = 3 (1)

One day work done by (B + C) = 2 (2)

By putting the value of 2C = A in (1) 

⇒ A + B = 3 

⇒ 2C + B = 3 (3)

By solving [2 × (2) - (3)] 

⇒ 2B + 2C - (2C + B) = 4 - 3 

⇒ B = 1 

By putting the value of B = 1 in equation (1)

⇒ A + B = 3 

⇒ A + 1 = 3 

⇒ A = 2 

One day work by (A + B) = 1 + 2 = 3 

Total work = 20 × 3 = 60 

**∴ No of days taken by B = 60/1 = 60**

questions.question: When the integer m is divided by 8, the remainder is 5. What is the remainder if 7m is divided by 8?

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

m = 8 × q + 5 [where q is quotient]

⇒ 7 × 8q + 32 + 3 

⇒ 7 × 8q + 8 × 4 + 3

⇒ 8(7q + 4) + 3

**∴ The remainder when 7m is divided by 8 is 3.**

Total odd days = 6 + 8

= 14
